name: DDL ingest SQL cancel must leave no live local ingest resource

payload.p_check: ADMIN CANCEL DDL JOBS or an equivalent rollback/cancel path reaches ADD INDEX local ingest after BackendCtx.Register has opened at least one engine.
payload.q_claim: When the cancel/rollback becomes terminal, every resource registered by that job is terminal: backend context removed, engine map empty, opened engines closed, writers closed, local sort data either cleaned or explicitly retained for retry, and no later unregister can double-close the same engine.
payload.fault_model: Cancel lands after local engine registration and before natural FinishAndUnregisterEngines completion. The harness must prove the active-resource window was hit before accepting a GREEN result.
source_anchors: pkg/ddl/backfilling.go:812 registers local ingest engines before executeAndClosePipeline
pkg/ddl/backfilling.go:840-851 closes or cleans engines after pipeline error/success
pkg/ddl/backfilling_read_index.go:185-196 has the dist-task local-ingest cleanup analogue
pkg/ddl/ingest/backend_mgr.go:118-179 builds backend context and exposes mockNewBackendContext for targeted instrumentation
pkg/ddl/ingest/engine_mgr.go:113-139 serializes FinishAndUnregisterEngines and clears bc.engines
pkg/ddl/ingest/engine.go:103-128 closes writers, closes openedEngine, optionally cleans local data

green: DDL job reaches cancelled/rollback-done or another explicitly allowed terminal state
backend_ctx_exists=false or live_engine_count=0 after terminal observation
opened_engine_count=0 and live_writer_count=0 after terminal observation
close_calls == cleanup ownership count; no close call repeats the same engine UUID
TiDB logs contain no close-of-closed-channel or DDL worker panic for the job
red: cancel returns or job is terminal while backend_ctx_exists=true with live engines/writers
a later retry observes stale ownership from the cancelled job
same engine UUID is closed twice or cleanup races with another unregister
DDL worker panic is observed for the job
invalid: operation finishes before cancel is delivered
observer cannot prove live resource count or backend context ownership

minimum_matrix.expected: RED at duplicate close or non-terminal resource
GREEN only if all terminal-resource observers pass

payload.stop_rule: Do not execute this refill target without instrumentation that proves active_resource_window_hit and exposes terminal resource counts.
